description: The live-DB sync tool, written and tested here but NOT run with --apply in this feature. Adds the DB half of backend-v2/scripts/standard_tabular_rollout.py (fingerprint, plan_changes, apply_changes with backup and single transaction, verify, roster.md report, CLI) and its temp-DB tests, then proves it read-only against the real lims.db with --dry-run. Needed because 9 of the 25 rows have drifted from their modules and 7 have no module, so the live write must be a surgical transform of the stored definition, never a module copy. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Extend backend-v2/scripts/standard_tabular_rollout.py (raw sqlite3, style of scripts/update_a2_0002_definition.py): `fingerprint(con)` = 57 rows, status counts Active 48 / Draft 4 / Inactive 3 / Superseded 2, PRAGMA integrity_check ok; abort on mismatch (expected values overridable by function arguments for tests).

`plan_changes(con, roster=ROSTER)`: for each ROSTER row locate by (code, version), require the expected status (Active, or Draft for TPL-A8-0003), compute convert_definition on the stored definition, run the structural-diff guard (only target groups differ, and only by kind/rows/rowLabel plus renderAsTable removal), audit_references, TemplateDefinition.parse + empty dry run, check_equivalence with the row's stored worksheets (read from test_worksheets by template_id), and the module-consistency check from the plan.md roster table (`equal` rows must equal SEED_TEMPLATES[code].definition after conversion; `drifted` rows must match the module's converted groups on kind/rows/rowLabel and the drifted group keys are listed; `none` rows are DB-only). Rows whose groups are already tables are skipped (idempotent); a missing ROSTER group aborts the whole run.

`apply_changes`: first take a backup with sqlite3.Connection.backup to `lims.db.bak-std-rollout-<UTC yyyymmdd-hhmmss>` next to the DB, verify its row count and integrity_check; then one `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction (timeout 30 s) running `UPDATE test_templates SET definition=?, modified_by='std-details-rollout', modified_date=? WHERE id=?` with json.dumps(new_def); verify inside the transaction; ROLLBACK on any failure; COMMIT otherwise. `verify(con, snapshot)` implements the post-state checks listed in plan.md item 8 (identity hash per row excluding definition/modified_*, definition == convert(pre), other 32 rows and test_worksheets hash-identical, module equality for the 9 `equal` rows, standard_2 tables in A4-0001/H1-0001/H1-0002, no renderAsTable in A4-0004, A2-0002 untouched).

CLI: `python -m scripts.standard_tabular_rollout --db <abs path> (--dry-run | --apply | --verify) [--report-dir <dir>]`. --dry-run and --verify open the DB with `file:...?mode=ro` and never write; all three write roster.md (per-row table: code, id, version, status, groups, source kind, drift list, equivalence variant counts, non-blank coverage) to --report-dir.

Create backend-v2/tests/calculation/test_standard_tabular_sync.py with a temp sqlite file built in the test (test_templates with the live columns, test_worksheets with template_id/context_values/group_values), seeded with reverted module definitions for three roster codes, one already-table row, one Inactive row and one decoy singleton in a non-roster group. Assert: fingerprint mismatch aborts before any write; dry run writes nothing; apply changes only roster rows' definition/modified_by/modified_date; Inactive and decoy rows untouched; second apply is a no-op; a poisoned definition (e.g. `if(standard.x, 1, 2)` in a calculated field) aborts the whole run with zero writes; the backup file exists with the same row count.

Run the read-only live check: `python -m scripts.standard_tabular_rollout --db d:\RD-instance\GIT\backend-v2\lims.db --dry-run --report-dir d:\RD-instance\GIT\.agents\tasks\std-details-rollout`. Record the file size and LastWriteTime of lims.db before and after (must be identical). Put the summary (25 rows, audit violations, equivalence diffs, drift list) in `findings`.
Commit locally: `feat(scripts): standard_tabular_rollout sync tool with fingerprint, backup and before/after verification`.
acceptance_criteria: The live --dry-run exits 0 and reports exactly 25 rows to convert (24 Active + TPL-A8-0003 Draft), 28 groups, 0 reference-audit violations, 0 equivalence diffs; lims.db size and mtime are unchanged afterwards.
roster.md exists in d:\RD-instance\GIT\.agents\tasks\std-details-rollout\ and is not staged in git.
The tool refuses to apply when the fingerprint is not 57 / 48 (covered by a test).
findings:
Committed 20e7da5 on std-details-rollout (not pushed). Only backend-v2/scripts/standard_tabular_rollout.py (part 2 appended) and the new backend-v2/tests/calculation/test_standard_tabular_sync.py changed. --apply was NOT run; lims.db untouched.
Verification: (1) pytest tests/calculation/test_standard_tabular_sync.py -q = 18 passed. (2) Live read-only run: python -m scripts.standard_tabular_rollout --db d:\RD-instance\GIT\backend-v2\lims.db --dry-run --report-dir d:\RD-instance\GIT\.agents\tasks\std-details-rollout = exit 0 in about 9 s; 25 rows to convert (24 Active + TPL-A8-0003 Draft), 28 groups, 0 reference-audit violations, 0 equivalence diffs, 0 problems; fingerprint 57 rows / Active 48, Draft 4, Inactive 3, Superseded 2 / integrity ok. lims.db before and after: Length 2600960, LastWriteTime ticks 639294984575671213 (identical). Module relationship: 9 equal, 9 drifted, 7 DB-only. Drift lists (informational): A2-0001 context; A2-0003 std_injections, bkt_injections; A3-0001 criteria, resultRef + 24 groups; A4-0004 unknowns_header, unknowns; A6A-0001 context, resultRef + 18 groups incl. standard; A6C-0001 context; A8-0001 context, criteria + 9 groups incl. standard; A12-0001 context, bkt_1_header, bkt_1, bkt_2_header, bkt_2, stats, preps; A13-0001 context. Equivalence replays: every row has empty, synth, pad3 plus stored-worksheet replays (28 ws replays on the 25 rows); non-blank calculated cells per row 11 to 510. roster.md written to d:\RD-instance\GIT\.agents\tasks\std-details-rollout\roster.md (outside the worktree, not staged). (3) seed_test_templates --validate-only exit 0. (4) Full pytest -q = 1075 passed, 5 failed = exactly the 5 known tests.
API for the db-loop: apply = python -m scripts.standard_tabular_rollout --db <abs lims.db> --apply --report-dir <dir> run from the worktree backend-v2; exit 0 ok, 1 plan/verify problems, 2 aborted (fingerprint mismatch, plan problems, backup or in-transaction verify failure; a failed apply rolls back and writes nothing). Backup file: lims.db.bak-std-rollout-<UTC yyyymmdd-hhmmss> beside the DB, taken only when there is something to change (second --apply prints 'no changes', takes no backup and leaves roster.md alone). modified_by='std-details-rollout', modified_date in SQLAlchemy format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff' (UTC), definition=json.dumps(new_def). --verify (read-only) compares the live DB with the newest backup beside it (or --backup <path>), refuses (exit 2) if no backup exists, and writes roster.md built from the backup's pre-state plan plus a 'Verify: all checks passed.' line. Python API: fingerprint, plan_changes, snapshot, verify, apply_changes, write_roster, main (main accepts roster/expected_rows/expected_statuses kwargs for tests).
Design notes / deviations: (a) plan_changes treats the roster id as a check too (id must equal ROSTER.template_id) and treats a vacuous equivalence run (0 non-blank calculated cells) as a problem. (b) apply re-reads each target definition inside the BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and aborts if it changed since planning. (c) verify also checks: modified_by is the actor only on changed rows, unchanged rows are byte-hash identical, no renderAsTable left on a converted group, A2-0002 still has the reference table, and re-runs the equivalence replay (pre-state vs current) when replay=True. (d) Files are CRLF in the working tree; both files were written as CRLF. (e) Plan said 25 worksheets on target rows; the replay count is 28 stored worksheets across the 25 rows (informational, not an acceptance criterion).
